measurements.first_token_ids_ms: first SSE event containing token IDs; runtime observation only
measurements.host_scope: available RAM, swap occupancy/activity, memory+IO pressure, global CPU, load, CPU temperature/frequency where available and workload process CPU deltas
measurements.memory_process_scope: candidate server process tree; RSS, HWM, PSS, anon/file, swap, before/peak/retained
measurements.model_load_seconds: process launch through /health; no warmup; source/model hashing is inside the campaign wall budget and file-cache state is uncontrolled
measurements.prompt_tokenization_ms: separate /tokenize request before replay; not included in generation latency
measurements.server_stage_timings: record only final-event fields emitted by the pinned llama.cpp build
measurements.temperature_sensor_policy: only CPU/package/Tctl/Tdie/coretemp labels count as CPU temperature; unrelated sensors retain their identity

active_q25_service.handling: record resident service and CPU deltas; never stop; report overlap

purpose: CPU-only runtime latency, memory, and actual prompt-cache reuse diagnostic; not a quality evaluation

replay.actual_terminal_rule: only runtime stop_type eos or word with truncated != true; cutoff/cancel/EOF are invalid and never repaired
replay.cache_evidence: record llama.cpp final-event tokens_cached and tokens_evaluated; cache_prompt=true alone is not reuse evidence
replay.input_plus_output_rule: input_tokens + 512 must be <= 3072; fail before generation, never truncate or context shift
replay.input_tokens: actual /tokenize result per fixture; no tokenizer substitution
replay.repeat_equality: compare raw UTF-8 output hashes between each primary and its immediately following exact same-prompt repeat
replay.transition_definition: distinct frozen source-state prompts sequenced through one slot; not live editor trajectories

revision_reason: Enforce an absolute 90-minute wall limit with a 10-minute finalization reserve, cancel an in-flight local HTTP request at the deadline, explicitly disable context checkpoints, and separate CPU temperature readings from Wi-Fi/GPU/SSD sensors.

runtime.execution_topology: one loopback llama-server process per precision, sequential; process group owned and stopped by runner
runtime.explicit_backend: CPU; --n-gpu-layers 0; per-run runtime log evidence is retained
